page.overview:
What is M-4 Army Combat Webbing?

The M-4 Army Combat Webbing was a model of load-bearing gear available in the period after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. It cost 100 credits, allowing its user to carry additional equipment.

Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook
